Fact: target_systems
What to find: Type and nature of AI systems the model can be integrated into (e.g. assistants, agents, RAG, decision support).
Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Agentic workflows and agentic coding harnesses (e.g. OpenCode, Pi, OpenHands) as backbone model; tool-calling/function-calling systems; multilingual dialog/chat assistants; reasoning-intensive tasks. Can be used alongside Granite Guardian for safety.
quotes: | **Best For** | Reasoning, Code Generation, Tool Calling, Agentic Workflows, Multilingual Dialog |
Granite-4.2-8B can be used as the backbone model for agentic coding tools.
**512K Context Window:** Supports long documents, multi-turn conversations, and complex agentic workflows.

To enhance safety in deployments, we recommend using Granite 4.2 alongside [Granite Guardian](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-guardian-4.1-8b) to detect and flag risks across key dimensions outlined in the IBM AI Risk Atlas.
